title: IELTS Speaking Intensive Full Mock Test - Cambridge 21

parts.title: Part 1: Phỏng Vấn Trực Tiếp (8 Câu - 2 Chủ Đề Chuẩn Format)
parts.instructions: Trả lời lần lượt từng câu hỏi giao tiếp đời sống (30 - 45s/câu).

questions.text: What city or town do you live in, and is it a big city or a small place?
What do you like most about your hometown, and is there anything you dislike about it?
What is your hometown famous for?
Is your hometown a good place for young people to pursue their future careers? Why?
Do you prefer to spend your free time with one close friend or with a large group of friends?
Where do you and your friends usually meet when you hang out?
Do you have a friend that you have known for a very long time?
Why are true friends so important in modern life?

parts.title: Part 2: Thuyết Trình Cue Card Chuẩn Khảo Thí (2 Phút)
parts.instructions: 1 phút chuẩn bị dàn ý trên nháp và 2 phút nói liên tục vào micro.

cueCard.topic: A Person Who Achieved Difficult Success
cueCard.prompt: Describe a person you know who did something difficult and was successful.
subPrompts: Who this person is and how you know him/her
What difficult challenge this person tackled
Why and how he or she was able to succeed
And explain how you feel about this person's achievement

parts.title: Part 3: Thảo Luận Xã Hội & Phản Biện Chuyên Sâu (4 Câu)
parts.instructions: Phân tích đa chiều, đào sâu nguyên nhân và hệ quả xã hội (50 - 60s/câu).

questions.text: What factors drive people toward ambitious goals in competitive societies?
Do you think financial wealth alone is an accurate measure of a person's life success?
Is it always healthy for young people to be intensely ambitious in their early careers?
Should parents unconditionally support their children's unconventional career ambitions?
